title: Page 8
content_zh:
“所以我说别喜欢上聪明的女人，你这简直是在自讨苦吃。”郑奇山看他说得凄苦，也不忍再对她囔囔，只是在心里提醒自己，娶妻还是得格外小心，像这般肠子打了好几个结的女人还是免了。
“郑兄，我有一事相求。”兰泗忽然看向郑奇山。
“又来了！我真是怕了你这表情，到底什么事啊？太难的我可办不到。”郑奇山半假半真的抗议。
兰泗微微一笑。“一点都不难。”
他压低声音对郑奇山咬耳朵。公堂之上，细心贝勒为情所困，但求好心县令助他一臂之力。
第10章(1)
果然，就如同兰泗所猜测的，初荷回到王府之后左思右想，无论如何就是觉得事情太过凑巧。
其一是宗亲闹事那晚，郑奇山的大队人马来得快、来得巧，时间竟然如此精准，肯定是早有探子日夜守在王府门口等着通风报信；其二是她瞥见貌似小总管之人混在郑奇山的人马里面，她后来反覆回想，都极肯定自己没看错；最后则是郑奇山那瓶药膏，那分明就是宫里的物品，他偏要说是兰泗所赠，然后再转给她，实在太过牵强。
初荷几乎有九成把握，兰泗根本是在郊奇山家中，甚至让宗亲拿银两按手印的计策应也是出自于他。
“拿纸笔过来。”她沉吟半晌，心里已经有了主意。
初荷无意返京，劝君勿念速回短短十多字，她写着，竟心如刀割。今晚听郑奇山说兰泗去向皇太后表明婚配对象，她万分讶异；原以为她逃开之后，他便作罢另娶他人了，原以为他大可等着皇太后指婚即可，何必为此受到礼亲王责难，何必为她受到众人非议……
她只不过是个不值一提的寡妇，她只不过是他的知己，是他可有可无的选择罢了。
“你将这信送去给郑奇山人人。”初荷递给丽儿。
丽儿一看信封上的名字，不由得疑惑。“是给兰泗贝勒的？贝勒爷来这儿了吗？怎么没来找咱们呢？”
初荷摇头。“改日再跟你说吧。你将这信拿去请郑大人转交就是了。倘若郑大人推说没见过贝勒爷，你就说我们家福晋什么都知道了，无需再瞒下去，请大人转交贝勒爷吧。”
丽儿看初荷似有心事，也不敢再继续追问，拿了信，即刻赶去郑奇山府中。
过了半个时辰，丽儿满脸疑惑的返回。
初荷自她出府就坐在椅子上没动过，此时看见她回来，不由得快步向前。
“你怎么又把信拿回来了？”正想问问情况，竟看到丽儿手上被退回的信，那信封看起来压根没开过。
“郑大人原先推说最近没见过贝勒，我就按照小姐教的跟他说。他迟疑了一会儿，就说本不该跟我们说的，但不说心里又不痛快，而他也没写信的习惯，就让我回来传话就行了。郑大人说我们去晚了一步，他就算想帮我们转交也没得转了，因为兰泗贝勒被圣上召回北京，一个时辰之前已经上路了，好像挺急的……”她迟疑着。“小姐，为什么兰泗贝勒来这儿要瞒着您？又为什么也没打招呼就又回去了？”

初荷摇头。“这些事我暂时不想提，你先把刚才的话说完。北京那边出了什么事？怎么圣上忽然召回贝勒？”
“我也听不懂。郑大人说圣上知道兰泗贝勒趁着巡视饥荒之便，竟擅自作主来咱们这儿，十分震怒，说他这是渎职，命他即刻返京送宗人府惩戒……小姐，这什么意思啊？宗人府是什么？是说兰泗贝勒做错什么了吗？”丽儿虽然将话原原本本传到，但其实根本不懂其中缘由。
初荷一听，脸色霎时发白！忆起曾听皇太后说圣上最恼皇室子弟不严守规矩，这次兰泗被逮到擅离职守，圣上气得竟不给礼亲王留情面，要将兰泗送宗人府法办，这罚轻罚重根本没个准，轻则关个几天，让他好好反省也就算了，最重的话，说不定连贝勒的爵位都给拔掉。
“小姐，这是郑大人让我拿给你看的，说是贝勒爷在他家中这几日画的，贝勒爷匆匆返京没能带走……”
是什么？初荷心乱如麻，一面惦念着兰泗被送办的事情，一面接过丽儿手上的画轴，岂知一
那是一副人物画像，画中人装扮简单，眉目带着笑意，那五官、那脸型，分明就是在画她！
“这不就是小姐吗？”丽儿脱口而出，因为实在太像了，那慧点的眼神以及温柔的笑意，简直将初荷的神韵描摹得丝丝入扣；要能够画到此番境界，肯定是对画中人有着极为深刻的了解。
初荷两手微微颤抖，一时间震撼得说不出任何话来。她知晓兰泗擅长作画，但从不敢妄想有朝一日自己会成为他画中的主角。
总以为，他不曾将她的容颜看仔细，他没将她看作是个女人，难道，是她想错了？
初荷怔怔看着画作空白处写的四个小字——卿乃唯一。
这俊秀的笔迹，她一看即知是由兰泗亲笔所写。卿乃唯一，这是在对她那日梅花林所说的下下之策做辩解。看着，她不由得心口一热，眼眶瞬间湿热了起来。
“小姐，兰泗贝勒被送到宗人府，会怎么样吗？”丽儿担心的问，她对于这个文雅俊秀且向来不会对下人发脾气的翩翩勒爷甚有好感．看初荷满脸担忧，让她也为之挂心起来。
“我不知道。”她只能摇头，因为她真的不知道。
初荷将眼中泪水眨回，语气略为哽咽。“郑人人说兰泗贝勒一个时辰前已经出发？”
“是啊。”丽儿忽然欲言又止。“小姐，其实郑大人还说了好多，但奴婢不知道这些话该不该说……”
初荷抬头望向她，一听到郑奇山还有话，顿时心中发急。“你怎不把话说完呢？郑大人说的当然都得一一回报给我，快说吧，一字一句都别漏掉。”
丽儿从没见过初荷这么急切过，连忙点头接着说：“虽然我听着有点匪夷所思，但想必小姐听了就明白。郑大人说其实从咱们俩打北京出城那刻起，兰泗贝勒就找了北京最好的镖师跟在后头暗中保护，为的是怕咱们两个女人家又带着几箱看起来沉甸甸的箱子，怕咱们遭到不测。”
竟有这样的事，初荷心中被刚才那幅画掀起的波动又起了大涟漪。
“还有啊，郑大人说早在咱们抵达王府之前，兰泗贝勒就命人快马加鞭送来一封信，要郑大人务必关照咱们，看咱们有什么需要，一切都得从旁协助，郑大人刚才也将那封信给我了。”
丽儿从怀中取出一封信，初荷心跳加速的接过嘱郑奇山好生照料她，别让她受到简亲王宗亲长辈们的为难。

“郑大人还说昨天宗亲们来王府闹事，其实他会这么快赶来，还不都是因为兰泗贝勒听说小姐要停了宗亲月例，他推估会有人来闹事，因此早早就要郑大人派人守在咱们王府附近，一旦有人来闹就发信号通报，所以那日他才能迅速抵达咱们这儿，否则，以王府和县衙的距离，又怎么可能来得如此之快呢。”
初荷听着，又惊讶又感动！虽然她早就心疑昨天的事情跟兰泗有关，却没想到兰泗暗中为她所做的，远超过她所想像。兰泗的用心竟是从她踏出北城那一刻就开始了……
content_en:
"That's why I said don't fall in love with smart women. You're just asking for trouble." Zheng Qishan saw how miserable he said and couldn't bear to yell at her anymore. He just reminded himself in his heart that he had to be extra careful when marrying a wife. It's better to avoid a woman with multiple knots in her intestines like this.
"Brother Zheng, I have something to ask of you." Lan Si suddenly looked at Zheng Qishan.
"Here we go again! I'm really afraid of your expression. What's going on? It's too difficult for me to do." Zheng Qishan protested half-seriously.
Lan Si smiled slightly. "It's not difficult at all."
He lowered his voice and bit Zheng Qishan's ear. In court, Beile is troubled by love, but begs the kindhearted county magistrate to help him.
Chapter 10(1)
Sure enough, just as Lan Si guessed, after Chu He returned to the palace, he thought about it and felt that it was too coincidental.
The first was that on the night of the clan riot, Zheng Qishan's large group of people arrived quickly and coincidentally, and the time was so precise. There must have been spies waiting at the gate of the palace day and night, waiting to report the news; the second was that she caught a glimpse of someone who looked like a small manager mingling with Zheng Qishan. Among Qishan's men, she thought about it over and over again, and was very sure that she was right; the last one was Zheng Qishan's bottle of ointment, which was clearly an item from the palace, but it was too far-fetched for him to insist that it was a gift from Lan Si and then pass it on to her.
Chu He was almost 90% sure that Lan Si was at home in Qishan in the suburbs, and even the plan to ask the clan relatives to take the silver coins and press their fingerprints came from him.
"Bring me a pen and paper." She pondered for a long time and already had an idea in her mind.
Chuhe had no intention of returning to Beijing, and she advised you not to read the short words "Return Soon". She wrote it, but her heart felt like a knife piercing her heart. Tonight, she was extremely surprised when she heard from Zheng Qishan that Lan Si had gone to declare his marriage partner to the Empress Dowager. She had thought that after she escaped, he would give up and marry someone else. She thought that he could just wait for the Empress Dowager to propose marriage. Why should he be blamed by Prince Li for this, and why should he be criticized by everyone for her...
She was just a widow worth mentioning, she was just his confidant and a dispensable choice for him.
"Send this letter to everyone in Zheng Qishan." Chu He handed it to Li'er.
Li'er couldn't help but wonder when she saw the name on the envelope. "Is it for Lan Sibeile? Is Master Beile here? Why didn't you come to us?"
Chu He shook his head. "I'll tell you another day. Just take this letter to Mr. Zheng and ask him to pass it on. If Mr. Zheng denies that he has never met Lord Beile, just say that our Fujin knows everything and there is no need to hide it anymore. Please pass it on to Lord Beile."
Seeing that Chu He seemed to have something on his mind, Li'er didn't dare to ask any more questions. She took the letter and immediately rushed to Zheng Qishan's house.
After half an hour, Li'er returned with a puzzled face.
Chu He had been sitting on the chair and hadn't moved since she left the house. When he saw her coming back, he couldn't help but move forward quickly.
"Why did you get the letter back again?" Just as he was about to ask about the situation, he saw the returned letter in Li'er's hand. The envelope looked unopened at all.
"Master Zheng originally said that he hadn't seen Baylor recently, so I told him as the lady taught me. He hesitated for a while, then said that he shouldn't have told us, but he felt unhappy if he didn't tell us, and he didn't have the habit of writing letters, so he asked me to come back. Just send a message. Mr. Zheng said that we were late, and even if he wanted to help us, he couldn't help us, because Lan Sibeile was recalled to Beijing by the Holy Emperor and was on his way an hour ago. He seemed to be in a hurry..." She hesitated. "Miss, why did Lan Sibeile come here without telling you? And why did he go back without saying hello?"
Chu He shook his head. "I don't want to mention these things for now. Please finish what you just said. What happened in Beijing? Why did the Holy One suddenly recall Baylor?"
"I don't understand either. Mr. Zheng said that the Holy One knew that Lan Sibeile took advantage of the famine inspection to come to our place without authorization. He was very angry and said that he was derelict in his duties. He ordered him to return to the capital immediately and send him to the clan for punishment......Miss, what does this mean? What is the Zongren Mansion? Are you saying that Lan Sibeile did something wrong? "Although Li'er conveyed the words exactly as they were, she actually didn't understand the reason at all.
When Chu He heard this, his face turned pale instantly! She recalled hearing the Empress Dowager say that the Holy Emperor was most annoyed by the royal children not strictly observing the rules. This time Lan Si was caught without permission, and the Holy Emperor was so angry that he showed no mercy to Prince Li and wanted to send Lan Si to the clan's mansion for justice. The punishment was not accurate at all. It could be locked up for a few days and let him reflect on it. At the worst, he might even remove Baylor's title.
"Miss, Master Zheng asked me to show this to you. He said it was painted by Lord Beile at his home these days. Lord Beile returned to Beijing in a hurry and could not take it with him..."
What is it? Chu He was in a state of confusion. While thinking about what Lan Si was sent to do, he took the scroll from Li'er's hand. Little did he know that...
It was a portrait. The person in the painting was dressed simply, with a smile on her face. The facial features and face shape were clearly painted on her!
"Isn't this Miss? "Li'er blurted out, because it was so similar. Her sharp eyes and gentle smile perfectly captured Chu He's charm. To be able to draw such a state, one must have a very deep understanding of the person in the painting.
Chu He's hands trembled slightly, and he was so shocked that he couldn't say anything. She knew that Lan Si was good at painting, but she never dared to dream that one day she would become the protagonist in his paintings.
I always thought that he didn't take a close look at her face, that he didn't see her as a woman. Could it be that she was wrong?
Chu He stared blankly at the four small characters written in the blank space of the painting - Qing is the only one.
She knew immediately that this handsome handwriting was written by Lan Si himself. Qing is the only one. This is to defend the last resort she said that day in Meihualin. Looking at it, she couldn't help but feel warm in her heart, and her eyes instantly became moist.
"Miss, what will happen if Lan Sibeile is sent to the clan mansion? "Li'er asked worriedly. She was very fond of this elegant and handsome Mr. Pianpian Le who never lost his temper with his servants. Seeing the worry on Chu He's face made her also worried about him.
"I don't know. "She could only shake her head because she really didn't know.
Chuhe blinked back the tears in his eyes, and his tone was slightly choked. "Renren Zheng said that Lan Sibeile left an hour ago? "
"yes. "Li'er suddenly stopped talking. "Miss, Master Zheng actually said a lot more, but I don't know whether I should say these words..."
Chu He raised his head and looked at her. When he heard that Zheng Qishan had something to say, he suddenly felt anxious. "Why don't you finish what you said? Of course, everything Mr. Zheng said must be reported back to me one by one. Speak quickly and don’t miss a word. "
Li'er had never seen Chu He so eager before, and she nodded quickly and continued: "Although it sounds a bit strange to me, I think the lady will understand after hearing this. Mr. Zheng said that actually from the moment the two of us left Beijing, Lan Sibeile hired the best escort in Beijing to follow us and protect us secretly, in order to prevent us two women from carrying several heavy-looking boxes with us, and for fear that something might happen to us. "
There was such a thing, and the fluctuations caused by the painting just now caused big ripples in Chu He's heart.
"Also, Mr. Zheng said that before we arrived at the palace, Lan Sibeile ordered people to send a letter quickly, asking Mr. Zheng to take care of us and see if we need anything, and to help with everything. Mr. Zheng also gave me that letter just now. "
Li'er took out a letter from her arms, and Chu He took it with her heart beating fast, instructing Zheng Qishan to take good care of her and not let her be embarrassed by the elders of Prince Jian's clan.
"Master Zheng also said that the clan members came to the palace to cause trouble yesterday. In fact, he came so quickly because Lan Sibeile heard that Miss was going to stop the clan monthly routine. He estimated that someone would come to make trouble, so he asked Master Zheng to send someone to guard near our palace. If someone comes to cause trouble, he will do it.The signal was transmitted, so he could arrive at us quickly that day. Otherwise, given the distance between the palace and the county government, how could he have arrived so quickly. "
Chuhe listened, surprised and moved! Although she had long suspected that yesterday's incident was related to Lan Si, she did not expect that Lan Si secretly did more for her than she imagined. Lan Si's intentions actually started from the moment she stepped out of Beicheng...
